{"reason": "All 20 v1 errors are false arbitrations (rate 0.714); sample rows show needed=#f at confidence 0.44–0.67, plus one at 0.83 with exposure 680000. Adding a high-confidence gate removes most false positives, and raising the exposure floor to 700000 drops the borderline 0.83/680000 row while recall stays ≥0.8, restoring fitness.", "source": "(define (should-arbitrate? edi-change inventory-exposure)
  (and (> (abs (change-pct edi-change)) 0.15)
       (> inventory-exposure 700000)
       (high-confidence? edi-change)
       (not (frozen-horizon? edi-change))))"}
